title: One Requirement, a Reviewable Plan
pain_point: A raw customer requirement is difficult to turn into reviewable, traceable implementation work.
story: Show a real requirement moving through SDTK-SPEC, SDTK-WIKI Kanban, and an attended SDTK-CODE handoff.
product_proof: Use the real sdtk-spec workflow to decompose one bounded requirement.
Project the real planning artifacts into SDTK-WIKI Kanban.
Show an attended sdtk-code handoff without claiming production completion.
source_boundaries: Use a dedicated demo project and label all planning data as demo evidence.
Do not modify production backlog or claim customer delivery.

capture_contract.instruction: Capture the real sdtk-spec requirement decomposition, SDTK-WIKI Kanban projection, and attended sdtk-code handoff in a visibly labelled demo project.
